import re


def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    # Replace spaces, apostrophes, and other special characters with hyphens
    text = text.replace(' ', '-')
    text = text.replace("'", '-')
    # Collapse multiple consecutive hyphens into one
    text = re.sub(r'-+', '-', text)
    return text.strip('-')


def truncate(text, n):
    if len(text) <= n:
        return text
    return text[: n - 3] + "..."
